N. of a king of Aṅga (and elder brother by the mother's side of the Pāṇḍu princes, being the son of the god Sūrya by Pṛthā or Kuntī, before her marriage with Pāṇḍu; afraid of the censure of her relatives, Kuntī deserted the child and exposed it in the river, where it was found by a charioteer named Adhi-ratha and nurtured by his wife Rādhā ; hence Karṇa is sometimes called Sūta-putra or Sūta-ja, sometimes Rādheya, though named by his foster-parents Vasu-ṣeṇa), MBh.; BhP. &c.
N. of several other men
कर्ण (mfn. कर्ण), eared, furnished with ears or long ears, AV. v, 13, 9; VS.; TS.
furnished with chaff (as grain), TS. i, 8, 9, 3.
(accord. to some also, कर्ण, ‘cropped or defective on the ears’) in comp.
a: कर्ण — a. Ved. 1 Having long ears. --2 Furnished with chaff (as grain). --र्णः 1 The ear; अहो खलभुजंगस्य विपरीतवधक्रमः . कर्णे लगति चान्यस्य प्राणैरन्यो वियुज्यते .. Pt. 1. 305, 304 also; कर्णं दा to listen; कर्णमागम् to come to the ear, become known; R. 1. 9; कर्णे कृ to put round the ear; Ch. P. 10; कर्णे कथयति whispers in the ear; cf. षट्कर्ण, चतुष्कर्ण &c. also. --2 The handle or ear of a vessel. --3 The helm or rudder of a ship. --4 The hypotenuse of a triangle. --5 (In prosody) A spondee. --6 N. of a celebrated warrior on the side of the Kauravas mentioned in the Mahābhārata. [He was the son of Kuntī begotten on her by the god Sun while she was yet a virgin residing at her father's house (see Kuntī). When the child was born, Kuntī, afraid of the censure of her relatives and also of public scandal, threw the boy into the river where he was found by Adhiratha, charioteer of Dhṛtarāṣṭra and given over to his wife Rādhā who brought him up like her own child; whence Karṇa is often called Sūtaputra, Rādheya &c. Karṇa, when grown up, was made king of Aṅga by Duryodhana, and became by virtue of his many generous acts a type of charity. On one occasion Indra (whose care it was to favour his son Arjuna) disguised himself as a Brāhmaṇa and cajoled him out of his divine armour and ear-rings, and gave him in return a charmed javelin. With a desire to make himself proficient in the science of war, he, calling himself a Brāhmaṇa went to Paraśurāma and learnt that art from him. But his secret did not long remain concealed. On one occasion when Paraśurāma had fallen asleep with his head resting on Karṇa's lap, a worm (supposed by some to be the form assumed by Indra himself to defeat Karṇa's object) began to eat into his lap and made a deep rent in it; but as Karṇa showed not the least sign of pain, his real character was discovered by his preceptor who cursed him that the art he had learnt would avail him not in times of need. On another occasion he was cursed by a Brāhmaṇa (whose cow he had unwittingly slain in chase) that the earth would eat up the wheel of his chariot in the hour of trial. Even with such disadvantages as these, he acquitted himself most valiantly in the great war between the Pāṇḍavas and Kauravas, while acting as generalissimo of the Kaurava forces after Bhīṣma and Droṇa had fallen. He maintained the field against the Pāṇḍavas for three days, but on the last day he was slain by Arjuna while the wheel of his chariot had sunk down into the earth. Karṇa was the most intimate friend of Duryodhana, and with Śakuni joined him in all the various schemes and plots that were devised from time to time for the destruction of the Pāṇḍavas.] --Comp. --अंजलिः the auditory passage of the outer ear. --अनुजः Yudhiṣṭhira. --अंतिक a. close to the ear; स्वनसि मृदु कर्णांतिकचरः Ś. 1. 24. --अंदुः --दू f. an ornament for the ear, ear-ring. --अर्पणं giving ear, listening. --आस्फालः the flapping of the elephant's ears. --इंदुः f. a semicircular ear-ring. --उत्तंसः an ear-ornament or merely an ornament (according to some authorities). karRaSUlasyAsADyatAM cAha । “mUrcCA dAho jvaraH kASaH klamo'Ta vamaTustaTA । upadravAH karRaSUle Bavantyete marizyataH” ॥ * ॥ karRanAdasya lakzaRamAha ॥ “karRasrotaHsTite vAte SfRoti viviDAn svanAn । pUyamityupalakzaRaM jalaM rasaYca srAvayet ॥ SravaRaSabdaH puMliNgo'pyasti ॥ * ॥ karRakaRqUmAha । “mArutaH kaPasaMyuktaH karRe kaRqUM karoti hi” ॥ * ॥ karRagUTamAha । “pittozmaSozitaH SlezmA kurute Siraso'rdDaBedakft” ॥ GrARaYca muKaYca ekatvaM dvande । Siraso'rdDaBedakft ardDAvaBedakAKyaSirorogakft ॥ * ॥ kfmikarRamAha । “yadA tu mUrcCatyaTavAtra jantavaH sfjatyapatyAnyaTavApi makzikAH । “pataNgAH SatapadyaSca karRaSrotraM praviSya hi । aratiM vyAkulatvaYca BfSaM kurvvanti vedanAm ॥ karRo nistudyate tasya taTA ParaParAyate । kowe carati ruk tIvrA nisyande mandavedanA” ॥ nisyande niScale ॥ * ॥ dviviDakarRavidraDimAha । “kzatABiGAtapraBavastu vidraDirBavettaTA dozakfto'karaH punaH । saraktapItAruRamasramAsravet pratodaDUmAyanadAhacozavAn” ॥ kzatapraBavoGAtapraBavaSca tayoraTAgantujatvAdEkyam ॥ asraM AsrAvamityarTaH ॥ * ॥ karRapAkamAha । “karRapAkastu pittena koTavikledakfdBavet” । koTaH pUtiBAvaH । kleda ArdratA ॥ * ॥ pUtikarRamAha । “karRavidraDipAkAdvA sakarRo vAripUraRAt । pUyaM sravati yat pUtiM sa jYeyaH pUtikarRakaH” ॥ * ॥ karRasrAvAdBedArTamAha । pUtanti niyamena pUti yaTA syAdevaM sravati ॥ * ॥ karRagatAnAM SoTArvvudArSasAM lakzaRAnyAha । “karRaSoTArvvudArSAMsi jAnIyAduktalakzaREH” ॥ kaRaSoTASca catvAro vAtapittakaParaktajAH । evamarSo'pi caturvviDam । anyezAM SoTAnAmarSasAYcAtrAsamBava ADArapraBAvAt ॥ arvvudaM saptaviDam । vAtapittakaParaktamAMsamedaHsirAjam ॥ ete karRarogA azwAviMSatiH suSrutoktA uktAH ॥ * ॥ idAnIM carakoktakarRarogacatuzwayaM vAtapittakaPasannipAtakftamAha । tatra vAtajamAha । “nAdo'tiruk karRatale tu SoTaH srAvastanuScAsravaRaYca vAtAt” ॥ * ॥ pittajamAha । “SoTaH sarAgo daraRaM vidAhaH sapUtipItasravaRaYca pittAt” ॥ * ॥ kaPajamAha । “vEsrutya kaRqUsTiraSoTaSuklasnigDastvatisvalparujaH kaPAcca” ॥ paripowakalakzaRamAha ॥ “sOkumAryyAt cirotsfzwe sahasEvAtivardDite । karRaSoTo Bavet pAlyAM sarujaH paripowavAn ॥ kfzRAruRAniBaH stabDaH savAtAt paripowakaH” ॥ * ॥ utpAtamAha । “gurvvABaraRasaMyogAt karRanAde bADiryye kzveqa eva ca ॥ caturzvapi ca rogezu sAmAnyaM mezajaM smftam । SfqgaveraYca maDu ca sEnDavaM tElameva ca । kaduzRaM karRayorDAryyametat syAdvedanApaham” ॥ 1 ॥ “laSunArdrakaSigrURAM vAruRyA mUlakasya ca । kadalyAH svarasaH SrezWaH kaduzRaH karRapUraRe” ॥ vAruRI varuRaH ॥ 2 ॥ “arkANkurAnamlapizwAn satElAn lavaRAnvitAn । sannidaDyAt suDAkARqe korite mftayAvfte ॥
